Another lady Aunt H is 91 years old.

If you just met her, you'd think she was in her 80s.

Very little wrinkles and great recollection of past events.

However she seemed tired of life.

Her husband had died 11 years earlier from cancer.

Her 4 children all became independently wealthy, all through her seed money.

She felt her life had less meaning.

In passing she mentioned that in Switzerland where her 2nd daughter lives euthanasia is allowed.

I reminded her that the church that she attends, the Catholic church opposes euthanasia.
